claim.label: incumbent process
claim.sentence: Industrial welding incumbent process A certified welder working from a drawing and a weld procedure, with quality riding on that individual's hand and day.

value.text: A certified welder working from a drawing and a weld procedure, with quality riding on that individual's hand and day.

assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: Manual welding is skilled, hot, and increasingly hard to staff; the shortage of certified welders is the reason this task keeps returning to the automation agenda.
